description: Reverse-ETL sink: mirror an upstream DataFrame into Chargebee Customer records. Chargebee uses POST for every mutating operation and has no upsert-by-key call -- POST /customers creates (fails if the id already exists), POST /customers/{id} updates (404s if it doesn't exist). This component looks up by lookup_field first via the list endpoint's '<field>[is]=' filter to discover an existing customer id, then issues the appropriate create-or-update POST. Two API calls per row.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one Chargebee Customer record (upserted via lookup_field).

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (rows_created / rows_updated / rows_errored / api_requests). No downstream data -- the write side effect lands in Chargebee.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

lookup_field.label: Lookup Field
lookup_field.description: Chargebee Customer field used to find an existing record via the list endpoint's '<field>[is]=' filter. MUST be present in fields_map values.

fields_map.label: Fields Map
fields_map.description: Upstream column -> Chargebee Customer field name.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (safety cap). No upsert-by-key endpoint -- each row costs 1 list-filter GET + 1 write POST.

name: Chargebee Customer Upsert
